modules.reason: Reads the repository filesystem directly, but silent skips and incomplete-directory semantics can still hide coverage gaps.
modules.next_gate: Propagate every scan/open/grow failure and emit a coverage ledger proving which repository roots were present, absent, skipped or failed.

modules.reason: Static TERMUX_PKG assignment extractor is useful but is not a complete Bash evaluator and does not establish full build.sh semantics.
modules.next_gate: Type unresolved expansions, TERMUX_SUBPKG semantics, conditional assignments and parser coverage; compare against a controlled Bash oracle.

modules.reason: Builds a real dependency graph from parsed fields, while alternatives/providers/conditional edges and exact SCC cycle decomposition remain incomplete.
modules.next_gate: Represent alternative/provider/conditional edges explicitly, propagate allocation failures and replace aggregate cycle detection with SCC decomposition.

modules.reason: CLI exposes the real scanner/parser/DAG path but inherits their semantic limits.
modules.next_gate: Emit the V2 evidence vector beside every result and refuse global REAL claims when any upstream axis is unresolved.

modules.reason: Metrics are derived from actual filesystem/DAG state, but the producer currently labels the whole output REAL even when upstream semantic coverage is limited.
modules.next_gate: Add coverage/parse-failure fields to the contract and distinguish measured graph metrics from global product/runtime readiness.

modules.reason: Fail-closed cross-field checks exist, but the compact C validator remains a textual extractor. The governed route now places a duplicate-aware, scope-aware strict JSON validator in front of it.
modules.next_gate: Keep the strict JSON gate mandatory and either replace the standalone textual C extractor with a bounded parser or explicitly deprecate standalone use.

modules.reason: Captures useful build/run provenance but does not by itself establish independent reproduction or device evidence.
modules.next_gate: Bind receipts to source tree hash, artifact hash, environment identity and an independently replayed execution.

modules.reason: Compile/runtime identity is observed while the legacy property table is now explicitly nominal. Static emulation claims were removed and a separate runtime capability probe was added; target execution receipts are still absent.
modules.next_gate: Validate the new runtime probe in CI, then collect independent execution receipts for each claimed target before lowering this P0.

modules.reason: The module now keeps unknown SoC identity unknown, probes CPU feature tokens/cpufreq when observable and no longer fabricates Generic ARM64, NEON or 2800 MHz defaults.
modules.next_gate: Collect physical Android receipts for topology/frequency/features and separate scheduler-model state from actual DVFS/affinity effects.

modules.reason: This is a host-side structural/model fixture. It has been relabeled to explicitly deny physical ARM/device validation and production readiness.
modules.next_gate: Keep structural regression tests here; create a separate device harness that receives real Android/Termux environment identity and artifact hashes.

modules.reason: The current backend is a CPU-backed deterministic GPU fixture. Synthetic devices are now gated behind RAF_ENABLE_GPU_FIXTURE=1 and are blocked by default.
modules.next_gate: Implement a real OpenCL/Vulkan/other explicit backend with physical device enumeration and measured kernel receipts before claiming GPU runtime.

modules.reason: Freestanding direct-syscall counter is concretely implemented for Linux x86_64; cross-architecture freestanding support is not established.
modules.next_gate: Add explicit ARMv7/AArch64 syscall backends and reproduce byte/runtime receipts on each architecture before widening the claim.

modules.reason: Uses real sockets but protocol framing, partial I/O handling, full deserialization, authentication and meaningful statistics are incomplete.
modules.next_gate: Implement framed messages, send/recv loops, strict parsing, authenticated peer identity, fault injection and multi-process receipts.

modules.reason: Contains orchestration structures but worker connect/assignment/heartbeat paths do not yet execute a distributed build contract end-to-end.
modules.next_gate: Connect workers through the RPC contract, assign real DAG slices, collect signed receipts and measure speedup only from homogeneous workloads.

modules.reason: The source explicitly simulates Ed25519-like behavior. Headers now identify it as SIMULATED_TOY and RAF_PRODUCTION_BUILD rejects inclusion at compile time.
modules.next_gate: Replace with a vetted Ed25519 implementation plus standard test vectors and a misuse-resistant API before any security claim.

modules.reason: The source explicitly simulates ChaCha20/Poly1305 and uses rand(). Headers now identify it as SIMULATED_TOY and production inclusion is compile-time blocked.
modules.next_gate: Replace with a vetted ChaCha20-Poly1305 implementation and standard vectors; use a secure nonce/key contract.

modules.reason: The source explicitly simulates Kyber/Dilithium-like operations with rand()/XOR. Headers now identify it as SIMULATED_TOY and production inclusion is compile-time blocked.
modules.next_gate: Integrate a vetted standardized ML-KEM/ML-DSA library with known-answer tests and explicit algorithm/version identifiers.
